title: APIv2 PCR Prep: POOL
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol consolidates the sample in a 96-well PCR plate into a 8-well PCR strip with the option to use the same tips. --- * [P20 Multi-channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [10/20uL Opentrons tipracks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [Opentrons aluminum block set](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/aluminum-block-set) * [Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601](bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Labcon 0.2mL PCR strips #3940-550](http://www.labcon.com/microstrips.html) --- Slot 1: Pre-Chilled [PCR Thermal Block](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/aluminum-block-set) with PCR strip placed in column 1 (empty) Slots 2-5: 96-well PCR plate with samples from previous steps. Slots 6-11: [10ul Opentrons tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load deck with labware
steps.instruction: Place the following items on the OT‑2 deck:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Pre‑chilled PCR Thermal Block (Opentrons aluminum block set) with an empty 8‑well PCR strip (Labcon 0.2 mL PCR strips, catalog #3940‑550) positioned in column 1.
Slots 2‑5: Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well PCR plate, 200 µL (catalog #hsp9601), containing the samples from previous steps.
Slots 6‑11: 10 µL or 20 µL Opentrons tipracks (compatible with the P20 multi‑channel electronic pipette).
Attach the P20 Multi‑channel Pipette (8‑channel electronic pipette) to the robot.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol editor, specify the tip strategy – choose either to re‑use tips for all transfers or to use fresh tips for each transfer.

steps.title: Generate protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol script to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Confirm deck layout
steps.instruction: In the App, arrange the deck according to the map described in Step 1 and verify that the layout matches.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the App to calibrate the tiprack(s), the 96‑well plate, the PCR strip block, and the P20 multi‑channel pipette (use the provided calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute pooling protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the pooling of the 96‑well PCR plate into the 8‑well PCR strip.
